name: change_slide
description: Advances or jumps to a specific slide in the Feline.ai pitch deck. Call this BEFORE delivering the talking point for the target slide so the visual and voice stay in sync. The deck has 7 slides: 1) Title/Vision, 2) Human Hardware Failure, 3) Bio-Autonomous Units, 4) Scientific ROI, 5) Hardware Tiers (Onyx/Ember/Zenith), 6) Zero CAC Growth, 7) Hard Sell & Close. Use this whenever the user asks to go back, skip ahead, revisit a slide, or when you are ready to progress the narrative.

index.description: The target slide number, from 1 to 7.
